reading: Honest-boundary outcome per preregistered interpretation table: every encoder arm acquires genuine discriminative power (P4), but cross-arm difficulty-profile agreement does NOT track geometry agreement, and C-S agreement cannot be distinguished from the shared-LM+shared-task floor (P3) at this budget/sample. Geometry is shared in the visual layer (static evidence unchanged); behavior-level difficulty under a frozen LM with projector-only training is dominated by LM prior + task structure.
